guides.brainstorm: Write it down first — tiny details are fine. Courses, lab meetings, papers, RA work, contests, failed attempts all count.
guides.cluster: Find connections, not polished sentences. Drag related points together.
guides.detail: Record the process without judging quality. Origin, process, outcome, problems, setbacks, knowledge, insights.
guides.compose: Build from existing details instead of inventing. Edit manually, or explicitly generate a draft.

brainstormPrompts: Was there a course project that took a lot of time?
Did a paper spark a follow-up idea you still remember?
Was there a lab meeting or talk with a teacher that stuck with you?
Did you get stuck debugging or experimenting, then suddenly figure it out?
Any contest, internship, or volunteer work tied to academic interests?
Any failed attempt that still feels worth writing down?

storyHints.process: What did you actually do along the way?
storyHints.knowledge: What knowledge or skills did you use?
storyHints.insights: Any sudden ideas or later realizations?

help.title: Help
help.quickStartIntro: Follow these five steps to capture experiences and find supervisors (same as the dashboard progress):
help.step0Desc: In Experience Pools, complete brainstorm → cluster → detail → compose as a reusable writing library; apply snippets to a profile.
help.step1Desc: Upload materials under Student Profiles and optionally bind one experience pool; refine further with AI chat. Activate at least one profile.
help.step2Desc: In Professors, add via Google Scholar, DBLP, university faculty-list crawl (list URL + LLM/CSS extraction), or manual entry. Refresh external Scholar/DBLP profiles for existing rows.
help.step3Desc: On Match Results, download Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B on first use (~1.2 GB from ModelScope), then run matching to get ranked recommendations.
help.step4Desc: Open a professor from match results and generate a personalized outreach email (uses detailed stories from the bound pool). Always review before sending.
help.apiKeyGuide: How to Configure an LLM API
help.apiKeyIntro: These features need an LLM API: resume parsing, experience-pool draft composition, professor profiles, paper summaries, contact letters, and profile AI chat.
help.apiKeyStep1: Pick a provider (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and create an account.
help.apiKeyStep2: Create an API key in the provider console.
help.apiKeyStep3: In Settings, choose API type (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic), then enter key, base URL, and model name.
help.apiKeyStep4: OpenAI-compatible example: base URL https://api.deepseek.com/v1, model deepseek-chat.
help.apiKeyStep5: Anthropic example: base URL https://api.anthropic.com, model claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Save and retry.
help.bpExperiencePool: Detail experiences in a pool before matching and letter writing for more concrete outreach material.
help.bpCompleteProfile: Complete your profile before matching — richer data yields better results.
help.bpScholarUrl: Google Scholar and DBLP complement each other; university crawls depend on site structure.
help.bpActiveProfile: Ensure one profile is active and you have at least one professor before matching.
help.bpReviewLetter: Always review AI-generated emails before sending.
help.bpRequestDelay: Default request delay is 3 seconds; increase it if Scholar crawling fails frequently.
help.bpAutoEnrich: Professor auto-enrichment toggles in Settings consume API credits — disable if not needed.
help.faqDataLocationA: Portable builds: choose a directory on first run; the path is stored in install.json next to the executable. Deleting the extracted folder does not remove your chosen data directory.
help.faqPortA: Close other Prof-Finder instances or restart your computer.
help.faqMatchDisabledA: Download the embedding model first; ensure an active profile and at least one professor exist.
help.faqScholarFailA: Check your network; increase request delay in Settings; retry later.
help.faqLlmFailA: Verify LLM API key, base URL, and model name in Settings, and check account balance.
help.settingsApiKeyHint: Resume parsing, experience-pool drafts, professor profiles, paper summaries, contact letters, and profile AI chat require LLM API configuration in Settings.
help.profileLlmRequiresApiKey: LLM auto-extraction requires LLM API configuration (including model name) in Settings first.
help.scholarModalIntro: Paste the professor's Google Scholar profile URL. The system will crawl publications and research interests in the background. Track progress in the top-bar task panel.
help.manualModalIntro: Enter basic professor information manually. Matching accuracy may be lower with minimal data — consider adding a Scholar / DBLP link or paper sources later.
help.matchPrerequisitesHint: Before running a match, ensure: one student profile is active, at least one professor is added, and the embedding model is downloaded on first use (~1.2 GB from ModelScope; requires access to www.modelscope.cn).
help.bannerSeeHelp: See Help in the top-right corner for detailed steps.
